body.name: \mathfrak R_T(P)
body.def: for \(P\in\mathcal U_{\mathrm{rr}}\), start at \(Y_0,X,W,\epsilon,Z^{\circ}\); recursively set \(U_t=g_{\beta_0}(Y_t,W_{t+1},X)\), \(K_{rs}(P)=P[U_rU_s]\), use the full past set \(D_t^{\star}=\{0,\ldots,t-1\}\), form \(\lambda_t(P)\) and \(\rho_t(P)\), set \(H_t=\lambda_t(P)^{\top}H_{D_t^{\star}}+\sqrt{\rho_t(P)}Z_t^{\circ}\), and \(Y_{t+1}=P[U_t]+\sqrt{\sigma^2}H_t+\epsilon_t\)
